Performs an evasive maneuver that reloads all equipped weapons and picks up Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.

Removes Combatant projectile tracking and disables Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

#Reload

source.text:
Performs an evasive maneuver that reloads all weapons and picks up Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.
